name: Nordoprost
summary: Prostate health and urinary function support

hero.subtitle: Support for prostate health, urinary function and normal sexual function
hero.intro: Nordoprost combines Graminex® G63® rye pollen, saw palmetto and willowherb for prostate and urinary support, with black maca adding support for vitality and normal sexual function.

audience.heading: A clearly defined role, without unnecessary complexity
audience.body: Designed for adult men with mild to moderate urinary symptoms that may occur with prostate changes, such as a weaker stream, frequent or nighttime urination and a feeling of incomplete emptying.

items.title: Prostate and urinary support
items.body: Rye pollen, saw palmetto and willowherb are combined to support normal prostate and urinary tract function.

items.title: Urinary comfort
items.body: The formula is designed for men seeking additional support for mild symptoms such as a weaker stream or frequent urination.

items.title: Sexual function and vitality
items.body: Black maca broadens the formula with support for normal sexual function, vitality and overall male well-being.

formula.heading: Different roles, one clear purpose
formula.intro: Urinary symptoms are not always caused by prostate enlargement alone, so medical assessment is important. In uncomplicated mild to moderate symptoms, Nordoprost provides combined nutritional and botanical support: three ingredients focus on the prostate and urinary tract, while black maca adds support for sexual function and vitality.
formula.calloutBody: Unlike formulas based on saw palmetto alone, Nordoprost combines four active ingredients. Rye pollen, saw palmetto and willowherb provide broader prostate and urinary support, while black maca adds a sexual-function and vitality component.

ingredients.heading: Composition and the role of each ingredient

items.name: Graminex® G63® polen raži
items.role: A standardized rye pollen extract and the central ingredient in the formula. Rye pollen extracts have been studied in men with mild to moderate urinary symptoms associated with benign prostate enlargement.

items.name: Testerasta palma
items.role: Serenoa repens fruit extract standardized to 25% fatty acids. Supports normal prostate and urinary tract function.

items.name: Vrbovica
items.role: Epilobium parviflorum has a tradition of use in formulations intended to support normal prostate and urinary tract function.

items.name: Crna maka
items.role: A 20:1 root extract. Supports vitality, energy and normal sexual function, contributing to overall male health and well-being.

useCases.heading: Practical situations for use
items: For mild to moderate uncomplicated urinary symptoms
For a weak or intermittent stream and frequent urination
For nighttime urination and a feeling of incomplete emptying
When support for normal sexual function and vitality is also desired alongside urinary support

notes.heading: Safe and responsible use
notes.warnings: Do not exceed the recommended daily dose. Not recommended for children or anyone hypersensitive to an ingredient. Nordoprost does not replace medical evaluation of urinary symptoms. Inability to urinate, blood in the urine, recurrent infections, severe pain or concern about another condition require medical assessment.
notes.legalNote: Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of the reach of small children. / Dodaci ishrani nisu zamena za raznovrsnu i uravnoteženu ishranu i zdrav način života. Čuvati van domašaja male dece.

purpose: NORDOPROST, 30 kapsula je dodatak ishrani na bazi ekstrakata polena raži (Secale cereale), ploda testeraste palme (Serenoa repens), korena make (Lepidium meyenii) i herbe vrbovice (Epilobium parviflorum).
